verdict.rationale: New Relic documents a built-in AI assistant for plain-language questions, troubleshooting, telemetry exploration, and query help. A built-in Security RX Agent also performs delegated work: it triages CVEs, drafts remediation steps, and opens Jira tickets or GitHub issues. Delegation is documented only for these narrow tasks, and broader delegation ("automated remediation") appears only as a marketing tagline. missing for 10: documented general-purpose task delegation and action-taking by the in-product assistant beyond Q&A and query help, depth of automated remediation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: It allows you to ask questions, troubleshoot issues, and explore telemetry data using plain language.
If you're struggling to get a query to work, ask our AI assistant to help you.
the agent triages the CVE, provides an analysis, drafts step-by-step remediation recommendations, and can open a Jira ticket or GitHub issue in the affected repository
The Security RX Agent assesses a vulnerability in the context of your tech stack and turns it into a suggested remediation plan.
